title: Reject DAO Origin Sequence zero in the production validator
description: P1 protocol/security: spec/05-routing.md §8.6 says Origin Sequence starts above zero and dao_origin_signature.json has reject_zero_sequence at the structural stage, but DaoOriginSignature accepts 0 and DaoOriginValidator.validate() never rejects it. A correctly signed sequence-0 DAO with no stored floor is therefore valid and DaoManager can persist its floor and install its route, contradicting the canonical vector and Rust/cross-implementation contract. Make zero a distinct structural rejection before signature/replay/semantics, wire the reject reason through DaoManager, and execute the canonical zero vector against production rather than only an independent test parser.
